title: KLF2-Mediated Modulation of oxidative stress and pyroptosis by Vanillic acid in intervertebral disc degeneration.
authors: Gong, Yuhang; Ye, Jiajing; Jiang, Ting; Shao, Shengzan; Li, Sijia; Li, Ze; Qiu, Jianxin; Zheng, Xiaohang; Zheng, Binbin; Jiang, Chao; Chen, Haixiao; Hong, Zhenghua
one_liner_zh: 该文研究香草酸通过KLF2/NRF2轴抑制椎间盘退变中的氧化应激和焦亡，仅涉及分子对接提示VA与KLF2的潜在结合，缺乏TF-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与课题关联较弱。
abstract: Intervertebral disc degeneration (IDD) is a major contributor to chronic low back pain, yet current treatments primarily offer symptom relief without addressing the underlying pathology. In this study, we demonstrate that vanillic acid (VA), a natural phenolic compound, protects nucleus pulposus (NP) cells from inflammation-induced pyroptosis, oxidative stress, and extracellular matrix (ECM) degradation. VA markedly reduced both intracellular and mitochondrial reactive oxygen species (ROS) levels and inhibited NLRP3 inflammasome-mediated pyroptosis. Transcriptomic analysis identified KLF2 as a significantly upregulated transcription factor in response to VA treatment. Molecular docking suggested a potential structural interaction between VA and KLF2. Mechanistically, KLF2 was found to mediate VA-induced activation of NRF2 signaling, as KLF2 knockdown abolished NRF2 nuclear translocation. In a lumbar instability mouse model of IDD, VA preserved disc structure and ECM integrity, accompanied by increased expression of KLF2 and NRF2 and reduced pyroptosis. These findings indicate that VA attenuates IDD progression by activating the KLF2/NRF2 axis and suppressing the ROS/NLRP3 cascade, and suggest that VA may serve as a potential compound for the development of KLF2-targeting therapies.
abstract_zh: 椎间盘退变（IDD）是慢性下腰痛的主要诱因，然而当前治疗主要提供症状缓解，并未解决潜在病理机制。在本研究中，我们证明香草酸（VA），一种天然酚类化合物，可保护髓核（NP）细胞免受炎症诱导的焦亡、氧化应激和细胞外基质（ECM）降解。VA显著降低了细胞内和线粒体活性氧（ROS）水平，并抑制了NLRP3炎症小体介导的焦亡。转录组分析鉴定出KLF2为响应VA处理而显著上调的转录因子。分子对接提示VA与KLF2之间存在潜在的结构相互作用。机制上，发现KLF2介导VA诱导的NRF2信号激活，因为KLF2敲低消除了NRF2核转位。在腰椎不稳小鼠IDD模型中，VA保留了椎间盘结构和ECM完整性，伴随KLF2和NRF2表达增加及焦亡减少。这些发现表明，VA通过激活KLF2/NRF2轴并抑制ROS/NLRP3级联反应来减轻IDD进展，并提示VA可能作为开发靶向KLF2疗法的潜在化合物。
